title: SFBond 실버폭스 #045 · 스테인드글라스 · 사각 오크 대들보 결박 · 체형 curvy petite · Slavic · late 40s · 헤어 hair in an elegant updo
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Slavic woman, a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 40s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white hair in an elegant updo — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge in an irregular cathedral-window mosaic, the panes small and numerous across her whole body, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every one of the hundreds of panes, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow. BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, no two adjacent panes quite the same shade, bright light passing through each tiny pane individually with sharp refraction glints, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A light smudge of soot marks her cheek and jawline, and a little soot dusts her fingertips, the backs of her hands and her bare feet. Her expression is a still, steady expression. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a massive square-cut rough-hewn oak timber beam mortised into two square oak posts that stand on either side of her, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a second square oak timber mortised into the same two posts at ankle height, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart. Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto nails to match.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
